title: Joomla Extension - balbooa.com - Unauthenticated deletion of submission/field files in Gridbox < 2.20.5.0…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla extension Gridbox from balbooa.com allows unauthenticated attackers to delete submission or field files. This issue affects versions prior to 2.20.5.0. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.9.
